title: Image Editor — Photoshop-style canvas (Konva)
description: A layered raster image editor built on Konva: layers panel (reorder, opacity, visibility, lock, blend modes), free transform (move/scale/rotate/flip), text + shape + image + paint layers, brush & eraser, non-destructive adjustments and filters (brightness/contrast/hue/saturation/blur/grayscale/invert/sepia), crop & resize, layer styles (stroke, drop shadow with angle/distance/size, outer glow, clipping mask), one-click background removal via @imgly/background-removal (free, in-browser, no API key), undo/redo, zoom/pan, and PNG/JPG/WebP export. Opens a file or starts blank; image in/out is via props (initialImage, onSave) so it drops into any app.
